Measurement on saved frames shows it CANNOT: sharpness_score is Laplacian variance, which scales with frame contrast/brightness; AE=short lowers luma by construction (19h matched-hour: luma 68.9->52.0), so it pushes MORE bursts below the floor, not fewer. Run 0006's own pre-registered 'midday regression => reconsider' trigger also fired (16h lap 19.18->15.07). FN unmeasured + plausible FN rise via the below-floor+no-animal mute path => FN-veto => reverted to AE=normal. AE mode is not the lever; the floor statistic is (backlog id 8, now active). AE=normal retained. See runs/0006.

CONCLUDED 2026-07-21 (KEEP, live). ROOT CAUSE behind exp #6/#5: min_sharpness_threshold=11.0 on raw Laplacian variance is a SCENE-BRIGHTNESS gate, not a blur gate (P(lap<11.0)=0% luma>=80, 71% luma 60-80, 100% luma<40 over 470 frames), so at dusk the blur-gate mute path fires as a function of darkness. Fix mirrors the existing 'no cv result' sentinel branch: _is_blank_prediction() (last taxonomy segment 'blank' AND all taxonomy segments empty) -> NO_ANIMAL, animals_detected=False, observability metadata preserved so top_species_raw keeps the blank label.
